user.title: Select Device Type
user.description: Choose your device model or the connection type it uses.

samsung_2878.title: Device Details (Port 2878)
samsung_2878.description: Enter your air conditioner's information. If you don't have the TOKEN, leave it blank and make sure the AC is turned OFF before continuing.

samsung_8888.title: Device Details (Port 8888)
samsung_8888.description: Enter your air conditioner's information. If you don't have the TOKEN, leave it blank to start the pairing process.

mim_h03.title: Device Details (MIM-H03)
mim_h03.description: Enter your MIM-H03 controller's information. If you don't have the TOKEN, leave it blank to start the pairing process.

rest_api.title: Device Details (REST API)
rest_api.description: Enter the details for your device. The token and device ID must be obtained manually according to your model's documentation.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Check the data (IP/Host, Token, etc.) and ensure the device is online.
error.pairing_init_failed: Failed to put the device in pairing mode. Check the IP address and that the device is online.
error.auth_failed_turned_off: Authentication error (Code 301). Pairing failed. Possible causes: power button not pressed in time (~20s) or AC was already on. Ensure the AC is OFF before starting and turn it ON when prompted.
error.token_acquisition_failed: Failed to obtain the token. Make sure to press the power button on the unit in time and that the IP is correct.
error.token_required_for_aiohttp: The 'Modern (aiohttp)' engine requires the token to be entered manually, as automatic acquisition is not yet supported with this engine.
error.mac_resolve_failed: Could not automatically resolve the MAC address. Please enter it manually.
error.device_id_required: Device ID is required for this configuration type.
error.port_in_use: The listening port (8888 or 8889) is already in use. Ensure no other pairing process is active.
error.timeout_8888: Timeout expired. Make sure to press the 'AP' button on the device within the next 60 seconds.
error.invalid_response: The device returned an unexpected response. Pairing has failed.
error.final_validation_failed: Final validation failed. Could not connect to the device with the obtained credentials. Please restart the device and try again.
error.cert_not_found: The certificate file was not found. Make sure the name is correct and it is in the integration's directory.
error.invalid_poll_interval: Invalid polling interval. Enter a number (seconds) or format 'hh:mm:ss'. Must be between 5s and 6h.

abort.already_configured: This device (same MAC address or ID) has already been configured.
abort.not_implemented: This device type is not yet implemented.

progress.awaiting_button_press: Waiting for user... Please press the power button on the air conditioner unit at **{ip_address}**. You have about 20 seconds to complete this action before the device cancels the process.
progress.awaiting_ap_button_press: Waiting for user... Please press the **physical AP button** on the indoor unit of the air conditioner at **{ip_address}**. You have about 60 seconds to complete this action.
progress.acquire_8888: Waiting for user... Please press the **AP** button on the air conditioner unit at **{ip_address}**. You have about 60 seconds to complete this action.
progress.initiating_pairing_8888: Initiating pairing with the device at **{ip_address}**. Please wait.

common.deprecated_yaml_message: Configuring Climate IP via YAML is deprecated and has been imported into the user interface. Please remove the `climate_ip` configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
